ValidationRule.description: If the Sub Type choosen is "CBB Amount unblock" , the cbb amount blocked fields cannot be updated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, 'CBB Amount unblock') && (ISCHANGED(BlockAmountBHDB__c) || ISCHANGED(CaseExecutionNumberB__c) || ISCHANGED(LetterReferenceNumberB__c) ) , true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update fields for the cbb amount block section
